learnings.title: Cerno Shorts: football and aviation topic tests from 28-day snapshot
learnings.claim: Repository TinyFish analytics summary for Cerno 2026-09-11 through 2026-10-08 reports 5300 views, 9.5 watch hours, +6 subscribers; Mbappe Short 2610 views, airplane window 1219, airplane seat 1122. These are reported snapshots, not independently re-fetched Studio metrics in this run.
learnings.decision: Run three original 30-second moving-footage concept tests in order: (1) Mbappe sprint mechanics explained without copyrighted broadcast clips; (2) surprising airplane window phenomenon with verified factual explanation; (3) airplane seat hidden feature with original demonstration. Select the next video only after hook/storyboard and licensing QC. Compare engaged views, stayed-to-watch/swiped-away, average view duration, retention and subscribers; do not infer causality from view ranking alone.
learnings.next_measurement: Retrieve fresh YouTube Studio per-video engaged views, stayed-to-watch, average percentage viewed, retention curve, and subscriber gains; compare these three concepts with the 2026-09-11 to 2026-10-08 baseline after publication.
failure_history: No direct YouTube Studio TinyFish browser analytics execution in this turn; 5300/2610/1219/1122 figures were read from Grok's committed 2026-10-09 report.
fallback_history: If fresh Studio metrics unavailable, label conclusions provisional and do not claim retention or swipe-rate improvements.
